Custom Blinds and Shades
in Hicksville, Ohio

Choosing a window covering involves more than matching a color. You need to consider what can be seen through it, how it opens, and how it will fit around your trim. An in-home consultation lets you compare those details at the actual window.

Beautiful Blinds & Shades is based in Fort Wayne. Contact David with your Hicksville, Ohio address, the rooms you want to update, and the best way to reach you. We’ll check whether we can visit your address and find a time that works.

The product choices below can help you prepare, whether you are replacing worn blinds or planning treatments for a new home.

Start with the style of treatment.

Then compare the material, privacy level, and controls for your windows.

Custom blinds

Adjustable slats let you change the incoming light. Compare wood, faux wood, and other materials by finish, care requirements, and the size of the opening.

Explore custom blinds

Custom shades

From cellular construction to the folds of a Roman shade, each style sits differently at the window. Compare how much light the fabric lets through and how much glass stays clear when the shade is raised.

Explore custom shades

Plantation shutters

Shutters use framed panels and adjustable louvers. Compare wood and composite materials, frame styles, and the clearance needed to open the panels.

Explore plantation shutters

A closer look
at fabric and function.

Bring the questions that matter in your home: a cold window, glare at the desk, a bedroom that needs darkness, or a shade you cannot reach.

Cellular shades and comfort

Cellular shades use pockets of air as an insulating layer at the window. Compare cell construction, light-filtering and room-darkening fabrics, and mounting options. How much they help depends on your windows, the shade you choose, and how it fits. We can explain the differences during your consultation.

Explore cellular shades

Solar screens and roller fabrics

A solar screen helps manage bright daylight with some outward view, while roller fabrics offer different privacy and room-darkening choices. Describe how you use the room after dark, too. A solar fabric by itself may not give you the privacy you need.

Solar shadesRoller shades

Roman shades and linings

Roman shades gather into fabric folds as they rise. Compare patterns beside your furnishings, ask which linings are compatible, and check how much glass the folded fabric covers when raised. In a bedroom, the mounting arrangement matters alongside the lining.

Explore Roman shades

Controls you can comfortably use.

Ask about available motorized systems for high windows or groups of shades. We discuss the selected product, control method, and power requirements together so you know what the setup involves.

Explore motorized options

Prepare for a useful consultation.

You do not need to choose every product before speaking with David.

List the rooms

Note which treatments you are replacing and which you plan to keep. Mention whether coordinating with existing finishes is a priority.

Point out the obstacles

Deep handles, shallow frames, nearby furniture, and uneven openings all affect the fit. A few photos or a description can help explain the project before the visit.

Discuss the new windows

For new construction, ask when final measurements should be taken. Discuss high openings and possible motorization before finishes make power access difficult.

Questions before you book

Contact David to discuss your address and the windows you have in mind.

Call (260) 222-6467
Can I request a visit in Hicksville, Ohio?

Yes. Our business is based in Fort Wayne, Indiana. Give David your address so he can check whether a visit is available.

What should I have ready when I call?

Your address, a rough number of windows, and a description of the rooms are a useful start. Mention unusually high or wide openings and any treatment you are trying to match.

Can I compare products without choosing a color first?

Yes. Start with what you need the treatment to do. Privacy, glare, access, and mounting details can narrow the choices before you select the finish.

What if my current blinds need repair or cleaning?

Explain the product and issue when you call. We’ll talk through what may help and how to arrange the service. Read more about blind repair and blind cleaning.
